name: relai-input-router
description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.321). RelAI Input Router: a large file (2000 tokens or more), a PDF over 5 pages or the large output of a reader command (cat, head, tail...) is read first by a helper model (claude-haiku-5-5 by default); Claude gets its notes with line numbers and a path to the full text. RelAI process files (docs/, PROMPT_ETAP_*, STATUS.md, PLAN.*, .claude/relai/), instruction files (CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, settings), secret files, small ranges, grep/ls/find, builds, tests, git and errors always reach Claude whole. Text with a secret found by the RelAI secret scanner never goes to the helper. Asks once per RelAI project (row 'Mody oszczędzania' in docs/USTAWIENIA.md) and stays passive in a session with no person before that answer. Sleeps while the BenAI 'input-router' mod is on. /relai-input-router shows stats; full lets the next large read through whole; off file / on file; model <id>. Notes are remembered by path, time, size and the ask (~/.claude/relai/oszczednosci/input-router/), and every hand-off goes to the RelAI savings ledger.
